declaration.dataset_role: CB4-S series roll flow (CH50): SCREEN block (earlier roll dates) and HOLDOUT block (latest roll dates); not prospective, not an edge claim
declaration.information_end: manifest request_clock_now (T_fetch7); every price and trade row capped at min(T_fetch7, T_seal 2026-10-22T00:00Z)
declaration.read_rules: verify listing hash first; append every read to ACCESS_LOG.jsonl; SCREEN reads refuse HOLDOUT and embargo units; HOLDOUT is read once, after the CB4 freeze, only for S tests that advanced; no outcome column is opened before the CB4 freeze commit; results are written outside this directory
declaration.split: time-ordered by roll date t0; D_split4 = smallest UTC date leaving <= 40% of roll units (after frame exclusions and removal of units with an h7_cb4_era member) at or after it; 3-day embargo dropped from both halves

split.inputs: t0 dates and market ids (units.jsonl.gz, era sample.csv.gz ids); no price, trade or outcome file was opened
split.rule: time-ordered by roll date t0 (section 1.3); 3-day embargo dropped from both halves
